decision.title: Like Phantoms, Forever
tracklist: This Is The Best Day Ever

rationale: Discography populator: full tracklist (3 tracks) per https://www.discogs.com/release/3684274-My-Chemical-Romance-Like-Phantoms-Forever, https://simple.wikipedia.org/wiki/Like_Phantoms,_Forever. CONFIRMED OFFICIAL RELEASE — it is real, not a fan compilation. Debut EP, a handmade numbered promo CDR on Eyeball Records with only 100 copies, handed out at a show in Rutland, VT (Dana Recreation Center) on September 21, 2002. Produced by Geoff Rickly (Thursday); recorded at Nada Studios. Track 3 is a live Morrissey cover recorded July 5, 2002 at American Legion, Cresskill, NJ. Technically the band's first official release ever, predating their debut album.
